title.narrative: Providing safe drinking water in the Chari-Baghermi and Hadjer-Lamis regions of the Republic of Chad

description.narrative: 10,000 people will have access to safe drinking water in the Chari-Baghermi and Hadjer-Lamis regions; access to clean water will increase in the beneficiary areas; quenching the thirst of the Chadian people and preserving their dignity; reducing the spread of diseases resulting from drinking contaminated water; and providing employment opportunities for at least 20 people through project activities, thus contributing to reducing unemployment.

The project aims to contribute to providing safe drinking water by supplying permanent and renewable water sources through the drilling of 10 artesian wells in the Chari-Baghermi and Hadjer-Lamis regions, where access to clean water is difficult. The project covers approximately 7% of the water needs in the targeted regions and 100% of the project's beneficiaries. It's important to note that the project's benefits extend beyond providing water for people; it also benefits livestock and is used for irrigating farms in some areas.
To improve the quality of life by providing safe and clean water to the most vulnerable communities in the Republic of Chad.
